info.name: CreateUser API – Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive automated test collection for POST /CreateUser API.
Includes: Positive (30), Negative (40), Edge (23), Security (10) test cases.
Total: 103 test cases.

Setup:
1. Import this collection
2. Import the environment file
3. Update auth_token, base_url, valid_role, valid_email_domain
4. Run collection via Collection Runner or Newman
